title: A short entry with no streak of obligations
description: A couple of check-ins help you start, and missed days do not close off continuing.

blocks.text: A long daily entry does not suit everyone. In the review below a person explains what helps him specifically: picking states and activities instead of having to describe everything in words.

quote.text: I attribute it to the ability to select activities/moods rather than having to write everything out, though I do usually add a blurb as well. I struggle with alexithymia so it’s a tremendous help to have a list with icons

blocks.text: Start with a check-in you recognize
Offer a small set of states or activities of your own and an optional text field. A new entry is available after any break; the earlier days are not devalued by a counter reset to zero.

What matters is whether a person can record what they need on a day with little energy left. A shorter form does not necessarily suit everyone; free text and changing your own set of check-ins have to stay available.
